description.value: Pizza Now is a pizza-focused fast food outlet in a Hillside Drive strip mall beside Canadian Tire in Kamloops. It offers delivery, curbside pickup, and a drive-thru window, making it a quick stop for a hot meal without needing to lock up for long. The menu centres on classic 12-inch pizzas ordered online or by phone.
